reviews.t: Not OEM part , may not work.
reviews.x: Plugged this in and it did not work. Now maybe i just got a bad one but this was not a true OEM ford part despite having the FoMoCo logo on it. I did some research and the sticker on the part itself will give you a good idea if this is a true ford part. If the P/N number is the same as the part number it is not a true part. Ford puts an “engineering” number in this space typically starting with H3CT.
Works perfect! Took maybe 5 minutes to switch out the old module with the new one. Looks identical to my OEM mod, lights are exact same blue as the rest of the interior lights. Super simple!

reviews.t: Enable Apple CarPlay on 2016 Ford’s with Sync2
reviews.x: This worked!!! 2016 Fords came with Sync 2. You can upgrade the software with a USB drive using an update from Ford.com, but Apple CarPlay will not work without this device. I was a bit nervous that the process wouldn’t work because of how long the upgrade to Sync3 took, but it works beautifully now. Part was easy to install, and worked immediately (you should upgrade Sync2 to Sync3 first before installing this part).

reviews.t: Easy replacement after i dumped a water bottle on a quick brake stop into the compartment.  .
reviews.x: I used nylon interior trim removal tools, from Harbor Freight to get behind the bezel of the old one and it pops right out.  Two quick release connectors, one for the USb one for power, snap it back into the opening and viola.. works great.  I'm a heavy  Apple IOS carplay user ( primarily maps) driving 100+ miles a day and the couple of days I was without it made me realize how much I rely on it.!

claims.text: Most reviewers report the module works perfectly to enable Apple CarPlay, often as a simple plug-and-play swap.
Several reviewers note that removing the old module and disconnecting its connectors can be difficult or fiddly, though this is not blamed on the part itself.
Some reviewers mention needing to update the Sync 3 firmware (e.g., to version 3.0) before the module works.
A few reviewers report the part did not work for them, with one noting a 'USB device is not recognized' message.
A small number of reviewers question whether it is a genuine OEM part or report fitment issues.
